test_apply_index: test the pandas tseries offset class with negative and positive n values on date_range and Series
create_offset_month_begin: create a MonthBegin offset and apply it to a DatetimeIndex to shift dates forward or backward
create_offset_quarter_end: create a QuarterEnd offset and apply it to a DatetimeIndex to shift dates to quarter end
create_offset_year_begin: create a YearBegin offset and apply it to a DatetimeIndex to shift dates to year begin
test_offset_business_month: test a BMonthBegin or BMonthEnd offset with negative n to shift business month dates on a DatetimeIndex
